evidence: The cleaner head features front and rear roller assemblies with blue and red drive components and a central slide-out Debris Tray.
These features provide positive evidence of the Dyson WashG1 wet floor cleaner family.
contradictions: Dyson V16 Piston Animal uses an All Floor Cones Sense dry head with coaxial conical rollers and lacks a Debris Tray.
Dyson V8 Absolute uses single-roller dry cleaner heads without a dual-roller debris tray mechanism.
Dyson Big Ball is a canister vacuum utilizing dry floor tools without dual wet rollers or a debris tray.

candidate_checks.evidence: The target head features front and rear wet roller assemblies with a slide-out Debris Tray, contradicting the V16 dry dual-cone head.
V8 Absolute uses single-roller dry floorheads rather than a dual-roller wet system with an integrated Debris Tray.
Big Ball canister cleaner heads do not feature motorized dual wet rollers or a Debris Tray.
